properties.site-address: Templars Square, Between Towns Road, Oxford
properties.notes: In July 2017, the Council's East Area Planning Committee resolved to grant planning permission (16/03006/FUL), subject to the signing of a legal agreement, for a mixed use development to include 225 dwellings. The site is a Primary District Centre in Oxford's retail hierarchy as set out in the Core Strategy. The site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings), for a mixed use development.
